briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race intensifies with xAI Memphis cluster online

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute constraints tighten. US export controls on advanced chips continue to reshape global supply chains. Multi-agent security protocols gain traction amid rising deployment risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with extended reasoning chains while Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek-V4 and Meta Llama 4 trail in benchmarks but close gaps on multilingual tasks. xAI Colossus-2 cluster enables 10x training scale.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC Arizona fab ships first 2nm wafers dedicated to AI. Microsoft and CoreWeave expand European data centers by 40%. NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1M units monthly.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced chips slow China's AGI timeline by more than 18 months?
